W37

Module editor

/teach/courses/:courseId/modules/:moduleId/edit
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S14

Organize a learning sequence with reachable prerequisites, clear opening rules and stable content references.

Entry and return
W35 add/edit moduleW16 preview return
Layout regions
HeaderModule title and saved/publication status
SequenceLessons, resources, assignment and quiz links with move up/down
RulesOpen/close, prerequisites, completion requirements and eligibility preview

States (4)
Empty module
WhenNo children
ShowsShow add lesson/resource/coursework choices
Way outAdd first item
Cycle detected
WhenModule 3 requires Module 4 which requires Module 3
ShowsExplain the cycle with links
Way outRemove dependency
Scheduled
WhenPublished but opening date future
ShowsShow exact opening time and learner unavailable message
Way outAdjust date through review
Child missing
WhenDeleted or permission-lost linked resource
ShowsKeep placeholder and block required progression
Way outReplace resource or remove requirement
Dialogs and drawers (2)
Change availability
  • Current/new dates and prerequisite rules
  • Learners with completed work and affected pending tasks
Return without applying changesApply reviewed rules
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Keyboard move controls produce the same order as dragging.
  • A cyclic prerequisite blocks publication with the path shown.
  • Removing a lesson does not erase existing completion history or received work.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
